title: Document Structure North Star v1 Checklist

items.label: Capture the Work path, owner repository, role, phase, checklist, evidence target, risks, and unknown state.
items.evidenceTarget: The north star record identifies Project Control ownership before writing product-wide structure framing.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-document-structure-north-star, owner repo-project-control, active role planning-partner with documentation-authority-steward responsibility, phase target phase-flowdoc-document-structure-north-star-v1, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-document-structure-north-star-v1, and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-document-structure-north-star-2026-09-04.

items.label: Write a failing Project Control guard before adding the north star records.
items.evidenceTarget: A focused test fails before Project Control contains the document-structure north star Work, document, checklist, and evidence records.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-document-structure-north-star.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed because flowdoc-product-development-resumption did not yet include flowdoc-document-structure-north-star as a child Work.

items.label: Define FlowDoc as document-structure definition without claiming implementation readiness.
items.evidenceTarget: The document states FlowDoc is a document-structure definition system, not a Word or Google Docs style editor, and not a PDF-only system.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-document-structure-north-star-2026-09-04.md defines the product north star and keeps it bounded to planning and terminology.

items.label: Define the v0 structure relationship boundary for document, section, component, field, style, page profile, and data binding.
items.evidenceTarget: The document records Structure Relationship Model v0 and the no-recursive-component rule while preserving future relation-table compatibility.
items.verificationNote: The north star names DocumentDefinition, Section, ComponentDefinition, ComponentInstance, FieldDefinition, DataBinding, PageProfile, and StyleDefaults, and states components do not contain active child components in v0.

items.label: Define Draft, Version, and Publication as separate responsibilities.
items.evidenceTarget: The document says Draft is editable, DocumentVersion is a frozen baseline, and Publication is a pointer to the selected frozen version.
items.verificationNote: The north star requires publishing through a frozen document version and keeps publication separate from version mutation.

items.label: Exclude runtime data, logs, audit trails, generated files, permissions, submissions, and implementation from the structure model.
items.evidenceTarget: The document keeps the next database design scoped to document structure only.
items.verificationNote: The north star explicitly states runtime data, submissions, logs, audit trails, generated files, and permissions are out of scope for this document-structure model.

items.label: Verify Project Control records, generated read model, and checks.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused north star guard, generated read model, Project Control data validation, and full Project Control checks pass.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence target: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-document-structure-north-star.test.ts --maxWorkers=1, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check.
